mapper.select: SELECT deptno, dname, loc, deleted FROM dept WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY deptno
SELECT deptno, dname, loc, deleted FROM dept WHERE deptno = #{deptno} AND deleted = 0

SELECT d.deptno, d.dname, d.loc, d.deleted, e.empno AS e_empno, e.ename AS e_ename, e.job AS e_job, e.mgr AS e_mgr, e.hiredate AS e_hiredate, e.sal AS e_sal, e.comm AS e_comm, e.deptno AS e_deptno, e.deleted AS e_deleted FROM dept d LEFT JOIN emp e ON e.deptno = d.deptno AND e.deleted = 0 WHERE d.deptno = #{deptno} AND d.deleted = 0 ORDER BY e.empno
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dept (dname, loc, deleted) VALUES (#{dname}, #{loc}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE dept SET dname = #{dname}, loc = #{loc} WHERE deptno = #{deptno} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE dept SET deleted = 1 WHERE deptno = #{deptno} AND deleted = 0
